articles.title: Harmony plans rollback, wiping 109,000 transactions after ONE exploit
articles.snippet: Harmony said selectively restoring transactions could create inconsistent chain state, as Ravencoin faces a separate rollback dispute after an exploit.

articles.title: BitMart account demands founder explain funds status, Xia calls claims ‘fabricated’
articles.snippet: BitMart’s Chinese-language X account demanded an Aug. 19 repayment plan, while Sheldon Xia called its claims of blocked withdrawals and non-payment of salaries “fabricated rumors.”

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s $116M self-custody wake-up call
articles.snippet: A $116 million Bitcoin wallet exploit puts self-custody under scrutiny as ETF inflows rebound, Strategy eyes more BTC and miners chase billions in AI deals.

articles.title: Hackers Are Abusing a macOS Screen Sharing Flaw to Secretly Mine Monero
articles.snippet: The Dutch cyber agency says attackers exploited an authentication flaw in macOS Screen Sharing to gain root access and plant Monero miners, with public proof-of-concept code now circulating.

articles.title: Anthropic's AI Agents Started a Virtual War. The Chat Logs Are Unhinged
articles.snippet: In a new red-team study, Claude models deployed self-replicating malware against each other—and the transcripts explain why.
